clauses.operator_claim: Next collapse/norm may consume rounded HcPost tiles, but current coefficient, future post, aux/Engram and tail readers keep residual materialization live. Whole4MhH removal is not implied.
clauses.applicable_domain: Current rounded BF16 HcPost→next delayed collapse; all readers/row generation must match.

clauses.operator_claim: Y collapse+RmsNormCast can remove one4MH Y interface; the FFN rounded BF16 plane and widened FLOAT semantics remain. Splitting Y/coefficient branch alone does not remove arithmetic.
clauses.applicable_domain: Same FFN row/Y generation, all BF16/FLOAT/rstd observers retained.

clauses.operator_claim: SingletonAdd, down-projection Add epilogue, and merge into HcPost are alternative cuts through the same merge. Preserve Down BF16 then merge BF16 before FP32 HC arithmetic.
clauses.applicable_domain: Shared+routed merge at a specific layer and row generation; not every Post boundary.

clauses.operator_claim: Direct local HC4 initialization preserves copy values but does not remove full4H HC coefficient normalization/projection. Initialization and first-pre producer fusion share the same initialized plane and need a joint all-reader cost.
clauses.applicable_domain: Draft initialization only; HcPre full-row numerics/parameter generation retained.

clauses.operator_claim: Router widening and full-E router epilogue may remove distinct FLOAT/logit interfaces; shared/routed experts still need rounded BF16 normalized values. Do not delete all normalized storage.
clauses.applicable_domain: Current FLOAT router branch; native nonlinear/ranking/tie/bias/weight and all reader contracts.

clauses.operator_claim: Shared quantization consumes rounded normalized BF16. Removing the router FLOAT plane is compatible only if this BF16 consumer remains; changing norm precision or reusing pre-round values is not implied.
clauses.applicable_domain: Identical norm generation and shared input row map; no private quantizer identity inferred.

clauses.operator_claim: Full constant-pad replacement may remove private helpers; virtual padding/row pruning additionally changes MC2 dispatch counts/workspace/mask ABI. Existing dispatch/FFN/combine fusion is the baseline.
clauses.applicable_domain: Observed800→816 prepare domain; unchanged MC2 EP/count protocol unless explicitly replaced.

clauses.operator_claim: Shared/routed common INT8 producer needs same rounded input, row map, mask, scales, quantizer and lifetime. Current MC2 BF16 input is not already the common prequantized ABI.
clauses.applicable_domain: Same input generation only; identical dtype is insufficient.

clauses.operator_claim: DownAdd may extend the shared branch producer through merge; it must wait for routed tiles, retain both BF16 rounds and account for changed overlap/buffering. Generic Add removal is counted once.
clauses.applicable_domain: Matching rows/current scaling and full fanout; finite Cube/Vector/HBM competition.

clauses.operator_claim: QA norm/quant and Q_B/IndexQ sharing refer to one QR quantized plane. Count its write/read once; distinct QB/IndexQ weights, outputs and row scales remain.
clauses.applicable_domain: Same QR generation and exact quantizer; M3 interface examples are not whole-request savings.

clauses.operator_claim: Q_B+IndexQ input reuse and joint output tiling can compose only with distinct output/scales/packing. The15384B example already includes the11532B quant-producer budget.
clauses.applicable_domain: Declared M3 QR1280, QB32768 and IndexQ4096; packed stride/layout support conditional.

clauses.operator_claim: QA+IndexWeight joint input must keep separate1280 and32 outputs. QA RMS cannot become RMS over1312 concatenated values.
clauses.applicable_domain: Same query hidden generation; preserve weight BF16→FP32 scale→FP16 rounding.

clauses.operator_claim: Local QA and global KV cannot be concatenated at identical M by shape convenience. Project-before-gather requires role-specific projected planes and actual ownership/readiness.
clauses.applicable_domain: Current QA3 vs KV24 example; global fallback/local-row repartition distinct.

clauses.operator_claim: KV projection/norm/RoPE/cache fusion can stream complete incoming rows or move compatible projections before gather. Global cache publication/full512 norm and reader/slot ownership remain.
clauses.applicable_domain: Current BF16 round boundaries and row-generations; no free communication removal.

clauses.operator_claim: IndexKey projection reads pre-RoPE compressor latent; fusing its long-KV norm/RoPE/cache path must retain the fork and finish old latent readers before in-place stores.
clauses.applicable_domain: Compatible C1/C2 long-cache branch; key scale and physical slot publication coherent.

clauses.operator_claim: C2 projected-row exchange may share local input cast/tiles, but both FLOAT WKV/WGATE outputs remain distinct and global pool state cannot be replaced by independent local pool.
clauses.applicable_domain: C2 direct dense FLOAT arithmetic; local/global row plan and input feature quantization fixed.

clauses.operator_claim: Joint WKV/WGATE projections feed pool then BF16 round/norm; separate output fields and pooling max/exp/sum order remain. Joint producer savings do not erase required pooled output work.
clauses.applicable_domain: C2 pool domain and FLOAT parameter arithmetic; no reassociation across nonlinearity.

clauses.operator_claim: Pool+norm and norm/RoPE/cache fusion overlap the normalized latent interface; pre-RoPE IndexKey readers prevent unconditional in-place deletion or assigning the same norm interface saving twice.
clauses.applicable_domain: BF16 pool/norm boundaries, all slot masks and latent readers retained.

clauses.operator_claim: Pool may fork norm and ring maintenance; one pool/update kernel needs all old observable ring reads before overwrite, physical page ownership and cross-program synchronization. Even-only maintenance is not half current projections or half unchanged allocation.
clauses.applicable_domain: Ratio2 observable ring domain, rollback/generation/all future observers retained.

clauses.operator_claim: F24 owner/dedup/cache reduces lookup work jointly on Uowned. Row-exchange WKV and head-partial WKV are alternative partitions; compare full downstream gate/norm/partial communication, not two independent TP factors.
clauses.applicable_domain: Active table format/version, head/shard/owner and post-lookup exact numerics required.

clauses.operator_claim: Tail row selection and lazy target-head/rejection pruning must use the union of all observer demands and one baseline. The native head already has row selection; removing norm/head rows cannot be counted twice.
clauses.applicable_domain: Target tail/head only; raw/probability/entropy/recovery/logprob/all future observers included.

clauses.operator_claim: Draft Markov serial token recurrence and target rejection/head rows are different computations. A confidence-derived budget must be known before a pruned prefix; it does not make noncausal decoder queries or raw hidden consumers dead.
clauses.applicable_domain: Frozen five-step Markov and target rejection contracts; RNG/global IDs/readiness preserved.

clauses.operator_claim: Direct attention send-layout writes may remove pack only for the chosen restore protocol. Moving WA before A2A changes the transmitted representation and weights; cannot additionally count elimination of the old pack twice.
clauses.applicable_domain: BF16 attention/inverse-RoPE boundaries and actual rank/head/row layout.

clauses.operator_claim: WA-before-A2A and token-owner WA+WB are different whole output partitions; full owner extends compute/weight replication and replaces communication. Count chosen partition payload and weights, not sum both communication savings.
clauses.applicable_domain: Current M=A condition; native per-group BF16 rounds and reduction policy retained.

clauses.operator_claim: WO_B→RS and RS→HCPost can tile pipeline, but each partial must undergo native BF16 reduction before HCPost. Same output/consumer buffer interface is removed once and both Cube stages share capacity.
clauses.applicable_domain: Exact TP group, row padding, native reduction order/all reader frontier.

clauses.operator_claim: Rejection full-write/count epilogue can feed accepted-state update. Preserve literal predicates/INT64 count vs INT32 destination and preload old values before in-place gather-map stores.
clauses.applicable_domain: Same B2/4 snapshot/generation and mixed-greedy/RNG ownership, not arbitrary per-row concurrent update.

clauses.operator_claim: Equal normalized planner keys can reuse a scheduling plan; those fields do not encode Q/K/V contents. New KV/query values still require attention. Cached plan identity is not activation identity.
clauses.applicable_domain: SWA saturated effective lengths/QSL/attrs fixed; actual cache bank/current token values may change.

clauses.operator_claim: A schedule key based on lengths/QSL/attrs does not establish equal index scores or selected indices. Reusing topK/indices needs their own source-value/key/generation and all-reader proof.
clauses.applicable_domain: Planner-defined fields only; no pointer/shape equality used for value CSE.

higher_order_groups.contract: Keep rounded BF16 shared/routed plane, separate FLOAT router/logit/removable interfaces; choose native/virtual padding ABI and quantizer before cost; preserve both merge rounds/HC consumers.
One QR quant producer, distinct query/globalKV domains and QA1280 norm. Joint packed layouts and projected-feature exchange must use the same role/row plan.
Distinct FLOAT projection fields→global row pool→rounded BF16 norm→preRoPE IndexKey fork/long-KV publication; old-ring WAR and observable-history retention survive new partitions.
Select one send/compute partition, preserve attention/WA/WB/reduction BF16 boundaries, price selected weights and all Cube/network/Vector resources jointly.
Target observer row-demand closure and separate draft recurrence, rawhidden/confidence, global best/RNG and accepted-state snapshot publication. A smaller row set is not blanket decoder liveness.
